system.description:
Level 1.

Your Health starts at 8, and you gain 2 Health every time you gain a level.

Warlocks can utilize their Maximum Health as a resource through Bloodloss. Some abilities have Bloodloss as an activation cost; others offer it as an option for strengthened effects. Bloodloss is a payment made from Maximum Health. You regain any lost Maximum Health at the end of the engagement and heal for half that amount.

Warlocks can momentarily store vestiges of Mana within themselves as Manaburn. Warlocks gain 1 Manaburn per 1 Mana expended. All Manaburn is lost at the start of the following Phase.
